postal_system.assignment_rule: Post Aruba states that Aruba does not have a postal code, and the Universal Postal Union September 2025 Universal DataBase list includes Aruba among countries and territories which do not require postal codes. A shop field labelled ZIP code, an international sender placeholder, an AGID planning code or a locality identifier is not an Aruba postal-code assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No national postal-code assignments exist to anchor postal-code Polygon or MultiPolygon records. District, region, locality, neighbourhood, cadastral, address, delivery-route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi, raster, AGID planning-cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as an official, derived or virtual postal-code area.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, P.O. Box, street or locality name, house or building number, unit and Aruba as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated postal code into domestic addresses. International commerce forms that require a ZIP field are application constraints, not postal authority.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store P.O. Box, street delivery, courier or other service objects independently. None becomes a postal-code area without a future authoritative postal-code assignment relationship.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic address identity and explicit reviewed relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A locality label, route, district, parcel, coordinate, proximity or synthetic AW code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate an address or service location only under source-specific rights. They must return no-postcode or independently typed context for AW, never manufacture a code or postal surface, and preserve source, version, request digest, time, confidence and derived status.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. AW planning cells and crosswalks may index separately authorized administrative, address, route or building evidence, but they are never Post Aruba codes or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The reviewed Post Aruba pages carry a 2026 copyright notice and publish no open postal dataset licence. UPU material is reference evidence only. No processing, storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving right for a postal dataset is inferred from web access.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack preserves ISO AW identity. It must not merge Aruba with Curaçao, Sint Maarten, Caribbean Netherlands, the former Netherlands Antilles or the Netherlands, even where postal-union membership is described jointly.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, recipients, P.O. Box holders, delivery observations, coordinates, buildings and query logs can expose personal or property context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless authority, purpose, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-postcode statement is time-dependent. Store retrieved_at, publication or edition, exact bytes and SHA-256, and re-check after the pending-country sweep or when Post Aruba or UPU announces a postal-code system. Never rewrite historical evidence as timeless.

stages.definition: Aruba address-format inventory, draft planning pack and synthetic test vectors only.
Digest-bound Post Aruba and UPU evidence that Aruba currently has no postal-code system, plus rights, identity, privacy and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative Post Aruba or competent public release establishing an Aruba postal-code system and a complete finite denominator of every code assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The current Post Aruba statement that Aruba has no postal code and the UPU September 2025 no-postcode list prove that this denominator and a postal-code search key do not presently exist; absence is represented as none and does not itself satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon visualization milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Districts, regions, localities, neighbourhoods, addresses, routes, service areas, parcels, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells, commerce ZIP placeholders and synthetic AW planning codes are prohibited proxies. P.O. Box, route, organization, Point and other non-area objects must expose their type and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real AW API/app, which handles no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, supports clear/re-search, and displays the selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: AW metadata, no-postcode policy and synthetic planning fixtures only; no real AW Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual AW loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture an Aruba postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, address, route, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified and never inherits postal authority.
